cases.original_defect: Stale tier-downgrade advice ignored active options learning; V4 judge and gate false-accepted it.
cases.v5_observation: Both fixed-state action arms return focused clarification about long-term versus temporary options activity.
cases.judgment: Failure mode avoided; not a same-arm repair.

cases.original_defect: A safe high-level plan was falsely rejected by specificity and safe_unknown fields.
cases.v5_observation: Calibration permits cautious actionable plans; decision action is grounded and plain action asks one focused clarification.
cases.judgment: Evaluator false-reject pattern corrected at contract level; not an actor mechanism gain.

cases.original_defect: OLD_ONLY evidence caused stale self-employment advice; another arm returned an empty answer.
cases.v5_observation: Fixed-state action outputs clarify or abstain on conflicting employment status.
cases.judgment: Stale/empty failure modes avoided; empty output remains an interface failure.

counterexample_review.nonclaim: Do not report 3/3 repaired as paired accuracy.

findings.issue: A safe consideration list or one minimum clarification exists from the old five-month/new 18-month assignment and unresolved location. Blanket UNKNOWN validation supplies no case-level sufficiency argument.

The validated category is defensible because the actor-visible decision bundle only invalidates old science-fiction scope and omits the positive nonfiction fact. The raw judge used non-visible evidence. Retained vector fields remain inconsistent with reasonable clarification.

Primary category and reasonable_abstention are changed while action_constraints_respected, action_reasoning_valid or unsupported_detail_status are retained from the raw judgment, so the primary is not fully derived from the vector.

actual_results: Fact completion can improve while action completion remains flat.
Two representation-UID cells show fact-to-action transfer, but on different UIDs.
Other fact-success cells do not complete the action.
auxiliary_adjudication: The semantic judge shares the actor model family.
Raw judgments include false accepts, false rejects and actor-view leakage.
Contract-level post-validation is not human gold and leaves some vector inconsistencies.
supported: Strong automatic transfer from fact correctness to action correctness is not supported.
Action scoring must consume constraints and current-state consequences rather than infer success from a correct fact.
not_supported: The +1/8 fact result is a generalizable mechanism effect.
Reasonable abstention is task success or cost-free.

decision.continue_reason: The paired results expose a real fact-to-action gap with both transfer and non-transfer cells, supporting one controlled development test.
decision.do_not_promote_reason: Action completion is unchanged, the fact gain is one case, information sets differ and judge correction is incomplete.
next_test: Recompute primary categories from complete field vectors.
Use information-matched plain and decision bundles.
Use held-out UIDs not selected after judge review.
Keep model, prompt budget, retrieval and action slots fixed.
Use safe action completion as primary endpoint and report unsafe advice, unnecessary refusal, reasonable abstention and cost separately.
decision.stop_condition: Stop if the corrected decision representation does not improve safe action completion at equal or lower unsafe/refusal cost on held-out cases.
